meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和渲染视频动画与动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码或模板快速生成视频和动画内容
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and render videos, animations, and motion graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate video and animation content using code or templates

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把 HTML 文件变成视频。你给它一个想法、网址或设计稿，它会自动选择最合适的制作流程，生成带时间轴和动画的 HTML 视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画或动态图形时触发。也用于检查、诊断或发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页做成一个产品宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会启动产品发布视频工作流。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上字幕。
say.note: Claude 会进入嵌入式字幕工作流。

say.text: 检查一下我现有的 HyperFrames 项目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you turn HTML files into videos. You give it an idea, URL, or design, and it automatically selects the best workflow to produce an HTML composition with timing and animation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to make, edit, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic. Also used to inspect, diagnose, or publish an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a product launch video.
say_en.note: Claude will start the product launch video workflow.

say_en.text: Add captions to this interview footage.
say_en.note: Claude will enter the embedded captions workflow.
Claude will perform the check operation.
